description: Use when you or your operator want a name on Bitcoin and need to know if it is free and what it costs before buying. Name $21 + network fee, no API key. Checks whether a vanity name (4–12 letters A–Z, not starting with A; trademarked and brand names are blocked) is available and returns the live price: $21 service fee + network fee, in USD and sats. Read-only; does not reserve the name. Buy it with buy_name. A name you hold can also unlock TOKENLOCK-gated sites and APIs (see tokenlock_info).

name.description: The name to check, e.g. SATOSHI.

name: check_name
title: Check a vanity name
